# `company.shipment_returns`

Shipment returns: units a shipment took, not yet invoiced, back into stock. Immutable; its state is its newest revision.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this shipment return. |
| `number` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | unique | — | — | Return number, from the shipment_return sequence. |
| `shipment_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_shipment_returns_shipment | shipments.id | Shipment whose units came back. |
| `sales_order_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | work_documents.id | Sales order of that shipment. |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | customers.id | Customer or job that sent the units back: the shipment's. |
| `return_date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | Date the units came back into stock, YYYY-MM-DD: the entry's date. |
| `reopen` | BOOLEAN | no | — | — | — | — | True: the units are to ship again on the order; false: they were cancelled on it. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | transactions.id | Journal entry the return posts as (inventory_documents kind shipment_return). |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this shipment return was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this shipment return. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this shipment return. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this shipment return. |
